current_example.problem: Given that $\dfrac{1 − 2a + 16b}{4} = p + qa + rb,$ what are the values of $p,$ $q,$ and $r?$
current_example.worked_solution:
Splitting the fraction into separate terms and then simplifying the fractions in the individual terms, we get

$$
\eqalign{
		\dfrac{1 − 2a + 16b}{4} &= \
		\dfrac 1 4 − \dfrac {2a} {4} + \dfrac {16b}{4} &= \
		\dfrac 1 4 − \dfrac {2} {4} \cdot a + \dfrac {16}{4} \cdot b &= \
		\dfrac 1 4 − \dfrac {1} {2} \cdot a + 4 \cdot b &= \		
		\dfrac 1 4 − \dfrac {a} {2} + 4b &= \
                \dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{1}{2}a + 4b &.
	}
$$

Writing the above in the form $p+qa+rb,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{{(\frac{1}{4})}_{⏟}}_{p}+{{(-\frac{1}{2})}_{⏟}}_{q}a+{{(4)}_{⏟}}_{r}b.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $p=\dfrac{1}{4},$ $q=-\dfrac{1}{2},$ and $r=4.$
